recommendation:
**These are two different schemes for different life stages:**

🎓 **Choose SGC Scheme if:** You are a single girl child, studying in classes 11-12 in a CBSE school, scored 70%+ in class 10, your family earns ≤ Rs. 8 lakh/year, and your school tuition is ≤ Rs. 3,000/month. This gives smaller monthly support (Rs. 1,000) but helps bridge secondary to higher education.

📚 **Choose NSPG Scheme if:** You are under 30, have completed your bachelor's degree, are enrolling in your FIRST postgraduate programme, and belong to economically weaker sections. This offers much higher monthly support (Rs. 15,000) but is for post-graduation only.

⚠️ **Key Differences at a Glance:**
- SGC is for girls only; NSPG has no gender restriction
- SGC caps tuition fees (strict rule); NSPG does not
- NSPG pays 15× more monthly but only for 1st PG degree
- SGC has a state affidavit requirement; NSPG uses eKYC with face authentication
- Both require school/institute verification and annual renewals

**Disclaimer:** This is AI-guided information only, not official notification. For final decisions, verify directly with https://www.cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html (SGC) or https://scholarships.gov.in (NSPG), or contact your school/institution.
